Record the session
Say something — the bar should move as you speak.
For best accuracy: lay the phone flat on the table roughly equidistant between doctor and patient, away from AC vents or equipment noise, and try not to talk over each other.
Recording only the clinical discussion: tap Pause during hands-on treatment, small talk, or breaks — resume when you're back to discussing history, findings, or instructions. A shorter, focused recording transcribes faster and more accurately than one continuous session.
recording
This now accepts any file type — some phones hide audio recordings when the picker is filtered to "audio only". Pick the recording file directly; we'll detect it's audio automatically.
Record the whole session in one go — the AI will separate doctor and patient speech automatically afterward.
Struck-through = what was heard. Green = what it was changed to. Worth a quick glance before trusting the note.
Your recording is saved on this device, separate from the transcript above. If transcription ever fails, your audio is safe and you can retry.
